input.brief: Land to Listings case study: real product screens and the project's surveyor plat, composed in the existing Bash Squad brand.

direction.name: The well-kept board
direction.idea: The project's plat and real screens fill a board of flat tiles.
direction.composition: Keep the existing layout: square tiles, 8px gaps, one dominant thing per screen and an independently composed phone layout.
direction.typography: Keep brand faces and five type sizes; no monospace, eyebrows or index numbering in case-study content.
direction.colour: Keep brand tokens; acid accent on the action and leading number. Client colours appear only within their work.
direction.imagery: Real product captures and the project's plat. No stock-photo substitutions, copied client datasets or reused client footage.
direction.pitfalls: No tile outlines, resting shadows, scrolling text, tilted screenshots or fake cursors in editable fields. Preserve shared site chrome.

hero.name: Name band and rails
hero.blueprint: Large name band, jump links, phone capture and facts, plat with statement, features and action. Preserve the existing scroll-built board and its release.
hero.mobile: Use the existing stacked phone composition, with readable content and complete art without desktop pinning.
hero.headline: Project name and a statement of at most 60 characters.

motion.name: Scroll-built plat and pinned story
motion.description: Keep the hero drawing, CSS section reveals, pinned screen story, one-time counters and visibility-controlled video with a pause control. Animate transform, opacity and clip-path. Reduced motion shows complete art, final counters and the video poster.

sections.name: Brief

sections.name: Pipeline
sections.blueprint: Project-specific MLS diagram with three named stages.

sections.name: Timeline

sections.name: Where it landed
sections.blueprint: Product recording, regional outline and current facts.

sections.name: Contact
sections.blueprint: Lead form in the accent tile, plain flank tiles.

sections.blueprint: Existing shared work-page footer; retain its brand conventions.
